title: Patna High Court Computer Operator-cum-Typist Admit Card 2026
organization: High Court of Judicature at Patna
vacancyDetails: 48 posts of Computer Operator-cum-Typist in Patna High Court
qualification: As per PHC Advt PHC/02/2026 (computer operator / typing eligibility)
ageLimit: 18 to 37 years for male (as per reported notice; check official advt for female/relaxations)
applicationFee: As per Patna High Court fee structure
selectionProcess: Written / CBT Examination → Interview / Skill as notified → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Login credentials; printed e-admit card; photo ID; identical passport photos
howToApply:
1. Visit https://patnahighcourt.gov.in
2. Open Computer Operator-cum-Typist Admit Card link
3. Login on digialm / exam portal

shortDescription: Patna High Court Computer Operator-cum-Typist Admit Card 2026 out on 15 July for exam on 22 July 2026 (48 posts).
content:
Patna High Court has released the admit card for Computer Operator-cum-Typist Recruitment Examination 2026 (Advt. PHC/02/2026) on 15 July 2026.

Exam date: 22 July 2026. Vacancies: 48. Application period: 17 April – 16 May 2026.

Download only from patnahighcourt.gov.in and carry original photo ID with the printed admit card.
